summary: Iteration 36: I re-tested the 5 fixes from iteration 35 and tested the new VIP dashboard on /vip-bookings. Backend: 29 of 29 pytest tests pass (7 new in test_iter36_vip_dashboard.py plus 22 from iteration 35). All 5 iteration-35 fixes are confirmed in both the API and the UI. The VIP dashboard works: the 6 tiles and tabs sort bookings into the right tabs and their counts match the cards shown; it was checked with a VIP who has bookings in every tab and with a non-VIP client. The URL ?tab= sync and deep links work, the Availability tab shows the editor for a VIP and the upsell for a non-VIP, and the Invited you / You booked tags are correct. Card actions work in the dashboard: confirm, opening the cancel dialog, VIP reschedule (the booking's own slot can be picked), withdraw, and the client accepting a VIP proposal. The /dates dashboard still works. 3 minor issues were found.

ui_bugs.issue: When Requests is empty, the page opens the wrong tab. It ignores price-list VIP bookings (db.date_bookings with vip=true). Cause: on mount, DateBookingList calls onItems([]) before its /dates fetch finishes, so `booked` is [] and the auto-pick effect (VipBookings.jsx line ~230) runs at once. Reproduced: client test_i36_a has requests=0, mine=1 (a price-list booking only) and confirmed=2, but the page opened Confirmed instead of My Requests.

When the VIP proposes a new time, the success toast says 'New time proposed — waiting for VIP confirmation' (bk_resched_sent). It should say the other person has to accept, for example rsch_sent. This also happens when the client proposes on a confirmed booking (it is a proposal, not an instant change), so the wording only fits the pending/instant case.

issues: The Availability pill (vs-tab-availability) does not fit in the max-w-5xl row. Only its icon or 'Av' shows at the right edge. After you click it the bar scrolls and Requests is clipped to 's 2'. Fix: let the bar wrap, shorten the labels, or put Availability on its own row.
The 'CANCELLED & REFUS…' tile label is truncated at lg:grid-cols-6 (same on /dates).

design_issues.issue_note: From reading the code only (not reproduced): <CancelledDates/> lists regular cancelled invites from /invites/cancelled. Those are not VIP bookings and are not counted in vs-tile-count-cancelled, so the panel can show the dates-empty-cancelled message and that list at the same time.
issues: Counts may not match the list when the user has cancelled regular invites

action_items: VipBookings auto-open: wait until DateBookingList has actually loaded before picking the first non-empty tab. For example, have DateBookingList call onItems only after its fetch resolves, or pass a loaded flag.
Use a neutral 'waiting for the other person to accept' toast (rsch_sent) when the VIP proposes a new time, or when the client proposes on a confirmed booking, in VipDateBookModal
Fix the Availability pill overflow on the /vip-bookings tab bar at desktop width
Optional: on the VIP Cancelled tab, either leave out CancelledDates (regular invites) or count those items, so the tile count and the empty state stay consistent
critical_code_review_comments: VipBookings.jsx auto-pick effect depends on `booked`, but `booked` is [] right after mount (DateBookingList onItems fires before its fetch). This is a race condition, not just a cosmetic issue.

VipBookings.jsx: the outgoing reschedule passes target name reschedule.vip_card?.name. For incoming bookings (the VIP rescheduling its own booking) vip_card is undefined, so 'VIP' is shown. This works but is generic.
DateBookingList price-list rows have no vs-dir-{id} tag (they use their own INVITED YOU / YOU BOOKED badge). The tagging is consistent visually, but the testids differ.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows work; 1 auto-open race, 1 toast wording issue, 1 layout overflow)
